items.reason: Both collect [Byte] and decode as UTF-8; tests in W3C_XML.Parse.Attribute Tests.swift.

String and bytes overloads call one parseDocument(_:maxDepth:entityLimits:); after the root only whitespace, comments and PIs are accepted, another element throws multipleRootElements, anything else expected("end of input"). A malformed XML declaration now reports its own error instead of being swallowed.

DOCTYPE parsed into Document.doctype (a second one is refused); comments before the root kept. Decision: Document.prologue changed from [Instruction] to [Content] (like epilogue) so comments and PIs keep their order; Parse.Document and W3C_XML.Parser fill it the same way. The Doctype internal-subset scan now skips quoted literals, comments and PIs instead of counting brackets (a ']' in a literal or comment ended the subset early). Helper renamed in 7380f0e7090c43f458122d07ca85065ade1adafc.

Decision: removed the iteration cap rather than throwing, since every loop iteration consumes input (Reference consumes or throws; empty CharData breaks), so the cap could only reject valid long text. Regression test parses 1,000,001 references (in W3C_XML.parse Tests.swift, committed with 966c95a).

items.item: `Sources/W3C XML/W3C_XML.Encode.swift`: CDATA text containing `]]>`, comment text containi
items.reason: CDATA is split (]]]]><![CDATA[>), round-trips exactly. Comments and PI data have no escape and the encoder does not throw, so they are made well-formed lossily: a space between each '--' and after a final '-', and between '?' and '>' in PI data (documented on the encoder methods).

items.item: Parse and resolve internal general entities with cycle, depth, and expanded-size limits and t
items.reason: Issue #6 has no checkbox list; the Acceptance line is treated as the item. W3C_XML.parse (string and bytes) reads <!ENTITY> declarations from the internal subset (first declaration binding, char refs expanded in literals, general refs bypassed, PE declarations ignored, processing stops at the first PE reference per §5.1) and includes replacement text in content (as markup, checked to be well-formed content on its own) and attribute values (as data). Typed failures: recursiveEntity, entityDepthExceeded(limit:), entityExpansionExceeded(limit:), externalEntity (external/unparsed entities are recorded but never resolved; no resolver API was added). Limits via new public W3C_XML.Entity.Limits(depth: 16, expandedBytes: 4 MiB) passed as parse(_:maxDepth:entityLimits:).

api_changes: W3C_XML.Document.prologue and Document.init(prologue:) changed type from [Instruction] to [Content]
W3C_XML.parse(_:maxDepth:) (String and bytes) gained a defaulted parameter entityLimits: W3C_XML.Entity.Limits
New cases on public enum W3C_XML.Parse.Error: externalEntity(String), recursiveEntity(String), entityDepthExceeded(limit:), entityExpansionExceeded(limit:)
Behaviour: parse refuses trailing non-markup after the root and a second DOCTYPE; Encoder output for CDATA/comment/PI text changes as described
dependents: No package outside swift-w3c-xml reads Document.prologue or switches over W3C_XML.Parse.Error (searched /home/user/cloud-workspace/repos).

notes: Entities are expanded only by W3C_XML.parse; the W3C_XML.Parse.Document combinator, W3C_XML.Parser and W3C_XML.fragment still reject custom entity references with unknownEntity. Expansion rewrites the input after the prologue before parsing, so parse errors inside expanded text carry no source offset (none are reported today anyway).
